newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sept S&P 500s end more than 20 points lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sept S&P 500s end more than 20 points lower.

text.p: June 23 - U.S. Sept S&P 500s futures ended more than 20 points lower. Sept fell nearly 24 pts on ideas Japan would sell U.S. Treasuries to stabilize exchange rates. Weakness in some interest-rate sensitive stocks, and jitters about tobacco cos also weighed on S&Ps, traders said. Sept ended below fair value.
